think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s data type and allowed values. 2) Check whether it is a numerical knob (integer/float) with a natural ordering. 3) If numerical, look for documented sentinel/special values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch the parameter into a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/ignore). 4) Decide: if such sentinel values exist and break the normal numeric interpretation, classify as a special knob; otherwise not. 5) If special, record the special value(s).
